t: Past the last of the air there is only dark and possibility. Things not yet made drift here, waiting.
Over the branches the work becomes a view. This is where the next limbs are planned.
Four limbs hold software, a van build, oil paintings and a hydroponic grow rack. Select a node to open a project.
The base of the trunk marks what is being learned right now.
Every project has a root that mirrors it. Notes, sketches, failures and research live down here.
The oldest notes sit furthest down: early experiments, dead ends and the research behind everything above.
The oldest ideas, the first attempts, the thinking underneath everything. Keep going and the loop returns to the stars.
